cases.prompt: Create a Surface application specification for a Welcome page at / that displays Welcome to Acme.
acceptance: The result is valid Surface 0.1 KDL.
The result contains exactly one application and at least one screen.
The application has no version property.
The screen route is / and a section paragraph displays Welcome to Acme.
The result does not introduce syntax from a later rung.

cases.prompt: Add a second paragraph saying Built with Surface to a valid rung-1 specification that contains a comment and a context node.
acceptance: The result adds exactly one ordered paragraph.
The existing comment, context node, and unrelated content are preserved.
The result remains valid Surface 0.1 KDL.

cases.prompt: Diagnose a file with no application, an unsupported component node, a screen identifier containing a space, and a numeric route.
acceptance: The response identifies all four Surface validation problems.
The response distinguishes valid KDL from valid Surface.
Every suggested correction uses only rung-1 syntax.
